items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the Dizzy Gillespie band returned from Europe without James Moody, who had just had a, just hit Moody’s Mood For Love.

ctx.x: ...musicians, we would get up and study our instrument, our craft–music–how we could excel. That was the art of the day, and this went on for years. Uh finally, in ’48 uh the Dizzy Gillespie band returned from Europe without James Moody, who had just had a, just hit Moody’s Mood For Love.
